_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/Riddle/tools/make_shape.py. Native frame, block units, the controller cell [0,0,0]; the operator stands to the north. The hand riddle: it rests on two bearers over the box and is lifted just off them and swirled while a charge is riddled. A hand station: no power cell, and no automated input or output (no infeed or output side for chutes or hoppers: the player loads and unloads it by hand). work is the riddling of one charge, W 0..1; k is the charge (1 a charge, 0 none); gauge windows are placed in charges. theta is the riddling clock, the player's hold-to-work, one turn a shake: nothing reads it but the shake's lobes, through its travel psi. The fines fall into the box (fines.pos) and the oversize stays in the riddle (charge.pos), both taken out by hand. See the riddle's README for the schema.

contents._comment: requires values for what the riddle holds: charge (the lumps and the layer of fines on the mesh) while a charge is on, at k 1; fines (the fines in the box) while the box holds fines, from the charge's loading until the player takes them out. While a charge is riddled the fines grow from nothing; with no charge on they are drawn whole.

riddling._comment: lumpsPerCharge: a charge's crushed ore, the lumps drawn on the mesh; shakesPerCharge: the pace, shakes (theta / 2 pi) a charge. #714's starting values (2026-10-14).
